persistence.implementation: Unmounted Mongo adapter; strict injected schema/configuration, expected revisions, immutable snapshots/modes, exact retry receipts, atomic encrypted audit and outbox reference; producer creates versioned pending delivery metadata
persistence.testDatabase: Disposable local one-node WiredTiger replica set; standalone rejection also verified
persistence.readIsolation: History uses a single database snapshot; each operation rechecks current server memberships
persistence.protection: AES-256-GCM with injected versioned read keys and record-bound additional data; separate keyed HMAC receipt fingerprints

outbox.implementation: Explicit one-entry worker with versioned configurable lease/retry policy, transactional delivery audit, version/token fencing, authenticated event loading and terminal quarantine/exhaustion
outbox.semantics: At least once; no event ordering promise. Consumers/providers must implement their own idempotency and revision handling.
outbox.audit: Every delivery-state transition commits with append-only worker/role/time/policy/before-after journal; lease tokens and private provider errors excluded

projection.implementation: Authenticated derived snapshot with contiguous revision and before-chain validation; atomic encrypted state, immutable consumer receipt and projection audit
projection.eventTrust: Reloads and authenticates the stored source event; callback payloads and timestamps are not authoritative
projection.duplicateHandling: Exact consumed IDs are no-ops; changed canonical intent rejects. Stale events do not regress state; gaps persist nothing and defer delivery.
projection.authorization: Reads require a request-local verified principal and fresh server policy/membership over authenticated stored scope
endToEnd: Producer/outbox/projection replay after lost acknowledgment commits one projection change
Out-of-order event retries and applies after its missing predecessor

transaction.implementation: Registered-store multi-record coordinator sharing individual staging/commit, requiring explicit versioned policy and pure detached-snapshot guard
transaction.atomicWrites: All participant records, immutable versions, audits, outbox entries, record receipts and encrypted group receipt
transaction.reads: Current per-record permission checks and one Mongo snapshot for the whole returned group
transaction.replay: Fresh authorization then original immutable results; changed intent or policy rejects; independently committed subcommands cannot be adopted as a group
transaction.scope: One client/database/namespace; no JSON store capabilities, no domain or provider operations

runner.implementation: Explicit single-use sequential polling runner with exact authenticated kind/schema routes, configured pacing and bounded consecutive infrastructure retries
runner.shutdown: Interrupts idle/backoff timers, prevents next claim, shares cancellation signal with active consumer and awaits its durable acknowledgment
runner.diagnostics: Detached process-local counters and fixed typed failures; no source content, event IDs, tokens or private exception bodies

leaseRenewal.implementation: Explicit optional versioned policy and frozen active-consumer control; count/lifetime bounds from original claim, exact ownership fencing and atomic queue/audit extension
leaseRenewal.completion: Serializes requests and drains accepted renewals before acknowledgment; any renewal failure prevents acknowledgment; capabilities close when the consumer settles
leaseRenewal.counters: Only queue version/expiry change; attempts, lifetime attempts and recovery count remain unchanged

managedConsumer.implementation: Opt-in exact route wrapper with configured sequential heartbeats and cooperative deadlines; consumers and accepted renewals drain before acknowledgment
managedConsumer.limits: Cancellation remains cooperative; trusted waits and handlers must honor abort, external provider effects require event-ID idempotency

deliveryHistory.implementation: Read-only snapshot pagination with current scoped permissions, separately authorized details and encrypted user/event/source/policy-bound continuation anchors
deliveryHistory.integrity: Structural validation of bounded contiguous rows and explicit saved/current anchors; plaintext journal history is not cryptographically authenticated

deliveryRuntime.implementation: Explicit lazy worker/managed-route/runner composition with detached key buffers/configuration and conservative configured renewal compatibility bounds
deliveryRuntime.lifecycle: Disabled/pre-aborted runs skip storage, failed initialization is retried under finite runner policy, successful worker is reused and caller owns Mongo client

recovery.implementation: Scoped metadata inspection and configured dead-delivery retry with expected queue version, coded reason, recovery budget and atomic audit/encrypted command receipt
recovery.counters: Per-cycle attempts reset only for authorized recovery; lifetime attempts, recovery count, queue version and journal history are preserved
recovery.sourceTrust: Immutable source event must authenticate before scope authorization; this port never edits or restores source data
recovery.replay: Fresh permissions and source-intent fingerprint; identical commands return prior results without a new reset
